_meta.description: Uncertainty distributions for Task 3.4. All values except carbon_price are dimensionless multipliers relative to base-case inputs. Carbon price is INR/tCO2e.
_meta.sweep_variable_axis: Variables are perturbed jointly in Monte Carlo analysis and independently in OAT analysis.
_meta.carbon_price_rule: Carbon price is a scenario assumption unless a verified applicable market price is supplied. It must never be presented as a universal Indian carbon tax.

fuel_price.source_notes: Existing repository assumption derived from Coal India notified price history.

electricity_tariff.source_notes: Existing repository assumption based on state ERC tariff trajectories.

biomass_cost.description: Delivered biomass procurement and logistics cost multiplier.
biomass_cost.source_notes: Biomass Atlas-derived seasonal uncertainty retained as an asymmetric upward risk.

efficiency.description: Relative useful-heat efficiency multiplier for the proposed technology. 1.00 = base efficiency.
efficiency.source_notes: Generic uncertainty band around the technology's supplied base efficiency. Replace with technology-specific evidence when available.

carbon_price.description: Scenario carbon price in INR per tCO2e.
carbon_price.source_notes: Not an official universal Indian carbon tax. Carbon price must be supplied as a scenario or verified market value. Zero is the default where carbon monetization is not applicable.

solar_capacity_factor.description: Solar production multiplier around the base-case yield.

capex_overrun.source_notes: Planning assumption; not a universal technology-specific overrun rate.

threshold.description: A spread ratio of at least 15% indicates a materially uncertain payback range.
